text_simplified: Among the pillars of upbringing is giving children constant advice and guidance toward lofty matters and noble character, beginning with matters of belief and the obligations of Islam, and, when warning, beginning with the major sins. These matters deserve the largest share of guidance, before worldly matters such as food and clothing. Among the most eloquent counsels is Luqman's advice to his son: he began with tawhid, then dutifulness to parents, then a reminder that Allah encompasses His creation, then establishing the prayer, and he closed with a set of lofty manners.
